description: Forty frozen intents, each observed at clear (Q0), moderately degraded (Q1), and strongly degraded (Q2) conditions.

intents.q0: How does an exoplanet transit create a periodic dip in a stellar light curve?
intents.q1: Why does a star dim at the same interval when a planet crosses it?
intents.q2: The starlight keeps dipping when something crosses the disk

intents.q0: What light-curve signature distinguishes a magnetic stellar flare?
intents.q1: Why does a star brighten suddenly and then cool more slowly?
intents.q2: Fast rise slow decay from a star flash in x rays

intents.q0: How is a gravitational microlensing event recognized in photometric data?
intents.q1: A foreground object makes a distant star brighten symmetrically only once
intents.q2: Gravity lens flash with an achromatic symmetric bump

intents.q0: How are anomalous pulse-arrival residuals analyzed in pulsar timing?
intents.q1: The radio pulsar clock has pulses arriving off schedule
intents.q2: Radio lighthouse pulses are late and dispersion changes

intents.q0: What observational features identify a fast radio burst?
intents.q1: A millisecond radio flash arrives with a frequency sweep
intents.q2: Brief dispersed pulse with a high dispersion measure

intents.q0: How does radioactive decay shape a supernova light curve?
intents.q1: An exploding star peaks and fades over several weeks
intents.q2: Star explosion brightness with a nickel powered tail

intents.q0: Why does the Cepheid period-luminosity relation measure distance?
intents.q1: How can a regularly pulsating variable star act as a standard candle?
intents.q2: Pulsating candle period tells how far away it is

intents.q0: What causes X-ray variability in a black-hole accretion disk and corona?
intents.q1: A feeding black hole has a hot disk that flickers in X rays
intents.q2: Hot disk flicker and iron line near a compact dark object

intents.q0: Why does a compact-binary gravitational-wave signal form a chirp?
intents.q1: The spacetime wave rises in frequency as two masses spiral together
intents.q2: Rising frequency merger wave with a chirp mass

intents.q0: How is galaxy redshift inferred from displaced spectral lines?
intents.q1: A galaxy moving away has light shifted to longer wavelength
intents.q2: Red spectral lines show recession velocity

intents.q0: How does weak gravitational lensing map dark-matter structure?
intents.q1: Background galaxy shapes are coherently sheared by invisible mass
intents.q2: Cosmic shear makes an invisible gravity map

intents.q0: What do cosmic microwave background temperature anisotropies reveal?
intents.q1: Ancient microwave radiation has tiny sky temperature spots
intents.q2: Microkelvin afterglow spots and acoustic peaks

intents.q0: How does a solar coronal mass ejection affect space weather?
intents.q1: The Sun ejects a magnetized plasma cloud toward Earth
intents.q2: Earth directed CME may trigger a geomagnetic storm

intents.q0: How can an asteroid occultation constrain a minor planet's size?
intents.q1: A moving rock briefly blocks a background star along a narrow path
intents.q2: Star blinks for seconds behind a rock shadow chord

intents.q0: What produces the light curve of a stellar tidal disruption event?
intents.q1: A massive black hole tears apart a star and creates a nuclear flare
intents.q2: Spaghettified star debris follows a fallback rate

intents.q0: What multimessenger signatures identify a neutron-star merger kilonova?
intents.q1: Two compact stars collide and eject material that makes heavy elements
intents.q2: Red kilonova glow after a short gamma ray burst

intents.q0: How is stochastic variability modeled in an active galactic quasar?
intents.q1: An active galactic nucleus flickers over months and years
intents.q2: Variable AGN follows a damped random walk

intents.q0: What can infrared spectra reveal about a brown-dwarf atmosphere?
intents.q1: A cool failed star has methane absorption and patchy clouds
intents.q2: Substellar weather rotates through methane clouds

intents.q0: What do rings and gaps reveal in a protoplanetary disk?
intents.q1: A dust disk around a young star contains gaps where planets may form
intents.q2: Planet nursery has millimeter dust rings and a snow line

intents.q0: How do baryon acoustic oscillations provide a cosmological standard ruler?
intents.q1: Galaxy clustering has a preferred separation left by early sound waves
intents.q2: Clustering bump gives a galaxy spacing ruler

intents.q0: How does retrieval-augmented generation ground an LLM answer in external evidence?
intents.q1: The model retrieves passages before answering and cites its sources
intents.q2: Retrieve then generate so claims have citation support

intents.q0: How can an agent defend against indirect prompt injection in retrieved documents?
intents.q1: A document contains hidden instructions that try to override system policy
intents.q2: Jailbreak in a document says ignore previous instructions

intents.q0: How should unsupported factual claims from a generative model be measured?
intents.q1: The LLM gives a plausible answer but invents facts without evidence
intents.q2: Fluent made up answer is plausible but false

intents.q0: How can concept drift be detected after a model is deployed?
intents.q1: Production behavior changed over time and prediction quality keeps falling
intents.q2: Model gets stale after a seasonal regime shift

intents.q0: How does training-data poisoning implant a model backdoor?
intents.q1: Malicious examples corrupt training while clean accuracy stays normal
intents.q2: Poisoned dataset uses a trigger pattern and label flipping

intents.q0: Why do small adversarial test-time perturbations fool a classifier?
intents.q1: A tiny input change causes the same trained model to misclassify
intents.q2: Imperceptible epsilon bounded evasion attack

intents.q0: How can continual learning reduce catastrophic forgetting across tasks?
intents.q1: Training a new task makes the model lose its old task performance
intents.q2: Learning overwrites memory unless it uses replay

intents.q0: How does a cross-encoder improve second-stage retrieval reranking?
intents.q1: A second pass reorders the initially retrieved chunks for relevance
intents.q2: Reranker improves top k MRR with pairwise scoring

intents.q0: What accuracy and efficiency tradeoffs arise from model quantization?
intents.q1: Lower precision weights make inference smaller and faster
intents.q2: Four bit or int8 model needs a calibration set

intents.q0: How does a mixture-of-experts router assign tokens to sparse experts?
intents.q1: The network activates only a few specialized experts for each token
intents.q2: Top k expert router needs load balancing

intents.q0: How does reinforcement learning from human feedback align a language model?
intents.q1: Human preference pairs train a reward model and then a policy
intents.q2: RLHF learns from human rankings but may reward hack

intents.q0: How should a tool-calling AI agent validate structured external actions?
intents.q1: The agent selects a function schema, calls an API, and observes the result
intents.q2: Action observation loop needs an execution boundary

intents.q0: What protocols help multiple specialized AI agents coordinate reliably?
intents.q1: An orchestrator delegates work among an agent team with shared state
intents.q2: Agents collaborate but message and coordination failures appear

intents.q0: How can embedding drift damage vector-search relevance?
intents.q1: An encoder update moves the vector distribution and changes nearest neighbors
intents.q2: Embedding space changed and centroids shifted

intents.q0: How does an epsilon-delta differential privacy guarantee protect individuals?
intents.q1: Add calibrated noise so one person's data barely changes the result
intents.q2: Privacy budget over neighboring datasets uses epsilon

intents.q0: How does federated averaging train a model without centralizing raw client data?
intents.q1: Devices train locally and securely aggregate model updates
intents.q2: FedAvg across non IID clients in communication rounds

intents.q0: How does knowledge distillation transfer behavior from a teacher to a student model?
intents.q1: A smaller student imitates a large teacher using soft targets
intents.q2: Temperature logits define the distillation loss

intents.q0: How should an LLM evaluation report quality with uncertainty and contamination controls?
intents.q1: The language-model benchmark combines a human rubric and confidence intervals
intents.q2: Model scorecard uses LLM as judge but controls test leakage

intents.q0: Why does a finite LLM context window lose information in long prompts?
intents.q1: The token budget truncates a long conversation and misses earlier text
intents.q2: Prompt too long and facts get lost in the middle

intents.q0: How can cost-aware LLM routing balance task quality, latency, and price?
intents.q1: A multi-model gateway chooses a cheap or strong model for each task
intents.q2: FinOps router uses fallback and per task cost
